reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 3 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nuggets.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 55 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
